name: Karin
source:
A mysterious girl claiming to be a sorcerer who suddenly tried to occupy the school with the goal of flying.
Though she strongly resembles [url=/c15167]Torii Karin[/url], who had previously occupied Mizuho Academy, Karin herself has no idea who she is.
[Translated from [url=http://cappuccino-soft.jp/lacryma-web/soranana/chara_karin.html]the official site[/url]].

[spoiler]Karin is implied to actually be [url=/c84557]Kumonomi Misora[/url]'s "Magical Weapon of Tactical Destruction", having manifested herself shortly after Misora received a "Magical Gemstone" (OOPArt) from [url=/c15171]Sagara Maiko[/url] (Who herself got it from [url=/c14446]Sagara Ichigo[/url]).[/spoiler]
